    static class Pair {
        int x, y;

        Pair(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

    static class Dinic {
        int n, m;
        int s, t;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;
        List<Edge>[] adj;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            adj = new List[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, cap));
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[v]) {
                    if (e.cap - e.flow < 1) continue;
                    if (level[e.u] != -1) continue;
                    level[e.u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int& cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj[v].size(); cid++) {
                Edge e = adj[v].get(cid);
                int u = e.u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || e.cap - e.flow < 1) continue;
                int tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                e.flow += tr;
                adj[u].get(adj[v].indexOf(e)).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int flow() {
            int f = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(level, -1);
                level[s] = 0;
                q.add(s);
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (int pushed = dfs(s, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) {
                    f += pushed;
                }
            }
            return f;
        }
    }

            if (yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;

            if (sci[xx][yy] == 'Z') continue;
            if (pos(tt + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
        }
        return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
    }
